fail_rules: If the image reads as abstract, atmosphere-first, texture-only, or subjectless, it must FAIL.
If the image does not read as a manufactured object immediately, it must FAIL.
If the ceramic read turns glossy, plastic, PVC-like, or toy-like, it must FAIL.
Check saturation: reject neon, RGB-clean, or oversaturated reads.
Check color harmony: reject pure white, pure black, and synthetic magenta drift.
Check material-color match: color must feel materially bonded, never flat digital fill.
material_read: Abstract digital pattern, woven plastic, toy-like texture.
fix_direction: Remove all non-white/grayscale colors; target porcelain-white #FAFAFA.
Introduce a clear, single manufactured object with defined contours (edge, rim, bevel, curvature).
Drastically reduce saturation and shift to a shadow-heavy, low-saturation palette.
Develop a matte, dry, dense ceramic material read with ultra-controlled eggshell microtexture.
Eliminate all glossy, plastic, or toy-like finishes.
Ensure material-color feels materially bonded, not like a flat digital fill.
Avoid abstract compositions or texture-only frames.
summary: The image fails completely as a white ceramic material study. It presents as an abstract, highly oversaturated, neon-colored digital texture with no discernible manufactured object. The material read is glossy and toy-like, directly contradicting the matte ceramic target. The color palette is extremely oversaturated and synthetic, and the image lacks any characteristics of a dry, dense, engineered ceramic.
